caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden display case with glass doors, standing on four rounded legs. Inside the display case, which is divided into two sections by a central frame, there is a painted scene with three-dimensional figures. The background consists of an architectural structure resembling a two-story building, featuring arches, columns, and a small tower on top, rendered in shades of brown, gold, and beige. The lower level of the structure is populated with five human figures, dressed in colorful robes of blue, green, pink, red, and white. One of the figures on the right side is positioned beside a brown animal resembling a lion. The backdrop is a dark blue sky, decorated with swirling white and gray clouds, crescent moons, and a scattering of stars, as well as occasional leafy plants and flowers on both sides. The overall composition places the figures in front of an architectural façade, with decorated details set against a celestial themed sky. The display case rests on a beige background.
title: Wax Group (Detail)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
